title: How to Use the Thrive Apprentice Widget Area

sections.heading: Adding Widgets to the Thrive Apprentice Widget Area

steps.raw_text: In your WordPress dashboard, go to **Appearance** > **Widgets**.
Locate the **Thrive Apprentice** widget area in the list of available widget areas. It may be labeled as **Thrive Apprentice Sidebar** or similar, depending on your theme.
steps.context: widget area in the list of available widget areas. It may be labeled as Thrive A

steps.raw_text: Click the widget area to expand it.
Click the **Add Widget** button (or use the block inserter if you're using the block-based widget editor).
steps.context: button (or use the block inserter if you're using the block-based widget editor)

steps.raw_text: Select the widget you want to add from the available options.
Configure the widget settings as needed (e.g., title, content, display options).
Click **Save** or **Update** to apply your changes.
steps.context: or Update to apply your changes
